definition: A long, curved yellow fruit.
examples: I eat a banana every morning.
The monkey took the banana.
These bananas are too green.

spanish.definition: Fruta larga, curva y amarilla.

definition: The things inside something; the information in a book, a website or a video.
examples: She checked the contents of the box.
He creates content for social media.
The content of this course is very useful.

spanish.definition: Lo que hay dentro de algo; información de un libro, sitio web o video.

definition: Having no hope; very bad at something.
examples: The situation is hopeless.
I'm hopeless at math.
She felt sad and hopeless.

spanish.definition: Que no tiene esperanza; muy malo para algo.

definition: A formal discussion between people with different opinions; to discuss something.
examples: Did you watch the presidential debate?
They debated the new law for hours.
There's a big debate about this issue.

spanish.definition: Discusión formal entre personas con opiniones distintas; discutir algo.

definition: A substance such as water that flows.
examples: Water is a liquid.
You can't take that liquid on the plane.
Drink a lot of liquids when you're sick.

spanish.definition: Sustancia como el agua que fluye.

definition: A very large meal for a special day.
examples: We had a big feast for Thanksgiving.
The king prepared a feast.
It was a feast of meat and fruit.

spanish.definition: Comida muy grande para un día especial.

definition: A written request for a job or a school; a computer program.
examples: I filled out a job application.
She sent her college application.
This application works on my phone.

spanish.definition: Pedido escrito de un trabajo o escuela; programa de computadora.

definition: A job that needs special training.
examples: Teaching is a beautiful profession.
He's a lawyer by profession.
She left the medical profession.

spanish.definition: Trabajo que necesita preparación especial.

definition: A long seat for two or more people.
examples: We sat on a bench in the park.
The players are on the bench.
There's an old man on the bench.

spanish.definition: Asiento largo para dos o más personas.

definition: A change in your body that shows you are sick.
examples: A cough is a symptom of the flu.
What are your symptoms?
The symptoms started last week.

spanish.definition: Cambio en el cuerpo que muestra que estás enfermo.

definition: A member of a youth club; a person who looks for information or new talent.
examples: My son is a Boy Scout.
A scout came to watch the game.
The soldiers sent a scout ahead.

spanish.definition: Miembro de un club juvenil; persona que busca información o nuevos talentos.

definition: A plane or a helicopter.
examples: The aircraft landed safely.
He repairs military aircraft.
All aircraft must stay on the ground.

spanish.definition: Avión o helicóptero.

definition: Ready to attack or to argue.
examples: That dog is very aggressive.
He's an aggressive driver.
Don't be so aggressive with your brother.

spanish.definition: Listo para atacar o discutir.

definition: Important or large.
examples: This is a significant change.
She made a significant difference.
There's been a significant drop in prices.

spanish.definition: Importante o grande.

definition: Related to seeing.
examples: I have a good visual memory.
The movie has great visual effects.
She teaches visual arts.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con ver.

definition: The office of one country's government in another country.
examples: I went to the American embassy for a visa.
The embassy is closed today.
She works at the Mexican embassy.

spanish.definition: Oficina del gobierno de un país en otro país.

definition: A piece of furniture with doors; the top group of government officials.
examples: The glasses are in the kitchen cabinet.
Check the medicine cabinet.
The president met with his cabinet.

spanish.definition: Mueble con puertas; grupo principal de funcionarios del gobierno.

definition: To show something; a place where things are shown.
examples: The store displays its shoes in the window.
Her paintings are on display.
This phone has a bright display.

spanish.definition: Mostrar algo; lugar donde se muestran las cosas.

definition: Being known by many people.
examples: He moved to Hollywood to find fame.
Fame changed her.
They rose to fame in the nineties.

spanish.definition: Ser conocido por mucha gente.

definition: Deep sadness.
examples: She felt deep sorrow when he died.
They shared their joys and sorrows.
His eyes were full of sorrow.

spanish.definition: Tristeza profunda.

definition: A strong room for keeping money safe.
examples: The money is in the bank vault.
Thieves broke into the vault.
She keeps her jewels in a vault.

spanish.definition: Cuarto fuerte para guardar dinero.

definition: To repeat the exact words someone said; a sentence someone said.
examples: She quoted a line from the Bible.
I love that quote.
Don't quote me on that.

spanish.definition: Repetir las palabras exactas de alguien; frase que alguien dijo.

definition: A punishment for breaking a rule.
examples: The penalty for being late is ten dollars.
The team got a penalty in the last minute.
What's the penalty for this crime?

spanish.definition: Castigo por romper una regla.

definition: A hot spice; a hollow vegetable, often red or green.
examples: Pass the salt and pepper.
This soup needs more pepper.
She put green peppers in the salad.

spanish.definition: Especia picante; verdura hueca, a menudo roja o verde.

definition: A hard hat that protects your head.
examples: Always wear a bike helmet.
The soldier took off his helmet.
He forgot his motorcycle helmet.

spanish.definition: Sombrero duro que protege la cabeza.

definition: A mark on your skin from an old injury.
examples: He has a scar on his face.
The surgery left a small scar.
How did you get that scar?

spanish.definition: Marca en la piel por una herida vieja.

definition: Too much worry or excitement about something small.
examples: Don't make a fuss.
What's all the fuss about?
He made a big fuss about the bill.

spanish.definition: Demasiada preocupación o emoción por algo pequeño.

definition: The part of a kitchen where you bake food.
examples: Put the cake in the oven.
The oven is very hot.
I forgot to turn off the oven.

spanish.definition: Parte de la cocina donde se hornea la comida.

definition: The part of a shirt around your neck; a band on a dog's neck.
examples: He loosened his shirt collar.
The dog has a red collar.
Your collar is dirty.

spanish.definition: Parte de la camisa alrededor del cuello; banda en el cuello de un perro.

definition: Only; nothing more than.
examples: She's a mere child.
It costs a mere five dollars.
The mere thought of it makes me sick.

spanish.definition: Solo; nada más que.

definition: Keeping things in a place until you need them.
examples: We put our furniture in storage.
My phone doesn't have much storage.
There's a storage room in the basement.

spanish.definition: Guardar cosas en un lugar hasta que las necesites.

definition: A set of steps you carry and use to climb.
examples: He climbed the ladder to the roof.
Hold the ladder for me.
She fell off a ladder.

spanish.definition: Conjunto de escalones que llevas y usas para subir.

definition: Another possible choice.
examples: We have no alternative.
Is there an alternative route?
This is a good alternative to meat.

spanish.definition: Otra opción posible.

definition: Related to a large company.
examples: She has a corporate job in New York.
He hates corporate life.
The corporate office is in Dallas.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con una empresa grande.

definition: People; traditional music or stories.
examples: Old folks need help in the winter.
She sings folk songs.
How are your folks?

spanish.definition: Personas; música o historias tradicionales.

definition: The back part of your foot or shoe.
examples: I have a pain in my heel.
She's wearing high heels.
My left heel hurts.

spanish.definition: Parte de atrás del pie o del zapato.

definition: A game for two people with sixteen pieces each.
examples: Do you play chess?
My grandfather taught me chess.
He's very good at chess.

spanish.definition: Juego para dos personas con dieciséis piezas cada una.

definition: A vacation on a large ship.
examples: We went on a cruise to Alaska.
They're taking a cruise this summer.
The cruise ship left Miami.

spanish.definition: Vacaciones en un barco grande.

definition: The most important; the first.
examples: Our primary goal is safety.
Red is a primary color.
She's his primary doctor.

spanish.definition: Lo más importante; lo primero.

definition: A musical instrument that you hit with sticks.
examples: He plays the drums in a band.
I could hear a drum in the distance.
She bought her son a drum.

spanish.definition: Instrumento musical que golpeas con palos.

definition: A vehicle with two wheels and an engine.
examples: He rides a motorcycle to work.
She fell off a motorcycle.
I want to buy a motorcycle.

spanish.definition: Vehículo con dos ruedas y motor.

definition: A large round container; the tube of a gun.
examples: The wine is stored in a barrel.
The price of oil is ninety dollars a barrel.
He looked down the barrel of the gun.

spanish.definition: Recipiente grande y redondo; tubo de un arma.

definition: Things carried on a ship or a plane.
examples: The ship carried a cargo of oil.
The cargo arrived at the port.
He flies cargo planes.

spanish.definition: Cosas que lleva un barco o un avión.

definition: A big, old gun on wheels.
examples: The soldiers fired the cannon.
There's an old cannon by the fort.
The cannon was heavy to move.

spanish.definition: Arma grande y antigua con ruedas.

definition: A person or a country that helps you.
examples: The U.S. is an ally of Canada.
He's my best ally at work.
The two countries are close allies.

spanish.definition: Persona o país que te ayuda.

definition: Between the ages of thirteen and nineteen.
examples: She has two teenage daughters.
He made bad choices in his teenage years.
I loved that band as a teenage girl.

spanish.definition: Entre los trece y los diecinueve años.

definition: To work together with someone.
examples: The two teams cooperated on the project.
Please cooperate with the police.
He refused to cooperate.

spanish.definition: Trabajar junto con alguien.

definition: Being friendly and helping others.
examples: Thank you for your kindness.
She treats everyone with kindness.
It was an act of kindness.

spanish.definition: Ser amigable y ayudar a otros.

definition: A connection between people or things; a member of your family.
examples: The two countries have good relations.
Her job has no relation to her studies.
He's a distant relation of mine.

spanish.definition: Conexión entre personas o cosas; miembro de tu familia.

definition: Clothing for women that hangs from the waist.
examples: She wore a long skirt.
I bought a black skirt.
That skirt looks great on you.

spanish.definition: Ropa de mujer que cuelga desde la cintura.

definition: A small green animal that jumps and lives near water.
examples: A frog jumped into the pond.
We heard frogs at night.
The princess kissed the frog.

spanish.definition: Animal verde y pequeño que salta y vive cerca del agua.

definition: A liquid with a nice smell that you put on your skin.
examples: She smells of expensive perfume.
He bought her a bottle of perfume.
I don't like strong perfumes.

spanish.definition: Líquido con buen olor que te pones en la piel.

definition: A group of people with the same goal; a connection.
examples: He joined the National Basketball Association.
The parents' association meets on Monday.
She has good associations with that city.

spanish.definition: Grupo de personas con la misma meta; conexión.

definition: A long piece of metal with a sharp point; a quick increase.
examples: There are metal spikes on top of the wall.
We saw a spike in prices.
His shoes have spikes on the bottom.

spanish.definition: Pieza larga de metal con punta afilada; aumento rápido.

definition: The number 11.
examples: A soccer team has eleven players.
I go to bed at eleven.
She's eleven years old.

spanish.definition: El número 11.

definition: A place where people can see art.
examples: We went to an art gallery.
The gallery is free on Sundays.
Her paintings are in a New York gallery.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde la gente puede ver arte.

definition: A hot spice from a root.
examples: I put ginger in the tea.
This cookie tastes like ginger.
He ordered a ginger ale.

spanish.definition: Especia picante que viene de una raíz.

definition: A hand with the fingers closed tight.
examples: He hit the table with his fist.
She made a fist.
He raised his fist in anger.

spanish.definition: Mano con los dedos bien cerrados.

definition: To make or become better.
examples: I want to improve my English.
Her health is improving.
The weather improved in the afternoon.

spanish.definition: Hacer algo mejor o volverse mejor.

definition: The act of making something new; something new that was made.
examples: This dish is the chef's new creation.
The law led to the creation of many jobs.
The story of creation is in the Bible.

spanish.definition: Acción de hacer algo nuevo; algo nuevo que se hizo.

definition: A disease caused by bacteria or a virus.
examples: She has an ear infection.
Clean the cut to avoid infection.
The doctor gave him medicine for the infection.

spanish.definition: Enfermedad causada por bacterias o un virus.

definition: A nervous feeling; a bad feeling between people.
examples: I could feel the tension in the room.
Exercise helps reduce tension.
There's a lot of tension between the two brothers.

spanish.definition: Sensación nerviosa; mal ambiente entre personas.

definition: An official paper that proves something.
examples: I need a copy of my birth certificate.
She got a certificate after the course.
He framed his marriage certificate.

spanish.definition: Papel oficial que prueba algo.

definition: Not afraid of taking risks; very clear and strong to see.
examples: That's a bold plan.
She made a bold decision.
The title is in bold letters.

spanish.definition: Sin miedo a tomar riesgos; muy claro y fuerte a la vista.

definition: A feeling of wanting what another person has; to have this feeling.
examples: I envy your free time.
He looked at my car with envy.
She envied her sister's life.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de querer lo que otra persona tiene; tener ese sentimiento.

definition: A very large sea animal.
examples: We saw a whale near the boat.
The blue whale is the biggest animal on earth.
Whales need air to breathe.

spanish.definition: Animal marino muy grande.

definition: To press the numbers on a phone; the round part of a clock or a machine.
examples: Dial 911 in an emergency.
I think I dialed the wrong number.
He turned the dial on the radio.

spanish.definition: Presionar los números de un teléfono; parte redonda de un reloj o una máquina.

definition: The good part of a bad situation; upside down means with the top at the bottom.
examples: The upside is that it's cheap.
Your picture is upside down.
The job is hard, but the upside is the money.

spanish.definition: Parte buena de una mala situación; upside down significa al revés.

definition: A magazine with drawings that tell a story; funny.
examples: My son reads comics all day.
He's a comic actor.
She bought a Spider-Man comic.

spanish.definition: Revista con dibujos que cuentan una historia; gracioso.

definition: Getting better after an illness; getting something back.
examples: She made a full recovery.
I wish you a quick recovery.
The recovery of the economy will take time.

spanish.definition: Mejorar después de una enfermedad; volver a tener algo.

definition: A person who works without pay; to offer to do something.
examples: She's a volunteer at the hospital.
I volunteered to wash the dishes.
We need more volunteers.

spanish.definition: Persona que trabaja sin pago; ofrecerse a hacer algo.

definition: Clean and in order; very nice.
examples: His room is always neat.
She has neat handwriting.
That's a neat idea!

spanish.definition: Limpio y en orden; muy bueno.

definition: To watch someone or something carefully.
examples: The doctor observed the patient all night.
We observed the stars from the roof.
She's observing a class today.

spanish.definition: Mirar a alguien o algo con cuidado.

definition: A series of events that repeat; a bicycle.
examples: This is the cycle of life.
The washing machine has a short cycle.
He's on a cycle tour of Europe.

spanish.definition: Serie de hechos que se repiten; bicicleta.

definition: A large white or gray bird with a long neck.
examples: A goose chased me at the park.
We had roast goose for Christmas.
The goose laid an egg.

spanish.definition: Ave grande blanca o gris de cuello largo.

definition: By mistake; without planning to.
examples: I accidentally deleted the file.
She accidentally broke the glass.
He accidentally called his boss.

spanish.definition: Por error; sin planearlo.

definition: The end of something; a decision after thinking.
examples: We came to the conclusion that he was lying.
Don't jump to conclusions.
Read the conclusion of the report.

spanish.definition: Final de algo; decisión después de pensar.

definition: The quality of being important.
examples: My mother taught me the importance of family.
This is a matter of great importance.
He doesn't understand the importance of sleep.

spanish.definition: Cualidad de ser importante.

definition: To clean a floor with a broom.
examples: Can you sweep the kitchen floor?
She swept the leaves outside.
He's sweeping the garage.

spanish.definition: Limpiar el piso con una escoba.

definition: Dangerous; with a chance of failure.
examples: It's risky to drive in the snow.
That's a risky investment.
She made a risky move.

spanish.definition: Peligroso; con posibilidad de fallar.

definition: The part of a vehicle that makes it stop; to stop a vehicle.
examples: The brakes aren't working.
He braked suddenly.
Hit the brake!

spanish.definition: Parte de un vehículo que lo hace parar; detener un vehículo.

definition: With nothing on it; showing no emotion.
examples: Write your name on a blank page.
The screen went blank.
He gave me a blank look.

spanish.definition: Sin nada encima; que no muestra emoción.

definition: Small; not serious.
examples: I have a slight headache.
There's a slight problem.
She has a slight accent.

spanish.definition: Pequeño; no grave.

definition: Something added; the action of putting numbers together.
examples: The new baby is a great addition to the family.
In addition, you'll get a free gift.
The kids are learning addition at school.

spanish.definition: Algo que se agrega; sumar números.

definition: The land and buildings of a college.
examples: She lives on campus.
The campus is very beautiful.
We met at the campus library.

spanish.definition: Terreno y edificios de una universidad.

definition: An animal that another animal hunts.
examples: The lion ran after its prey.
Mice are prey for owls.
The eagle dropped down on its prey.

spanish.definition: Animal que otro animal caza.

definition: To finish school or college.
examples: She graduated from college last year.
I'll graduate in June.
He's graduating from high school.

spanish.definition: Terminar la escuela o la universidad.

definition: Real; true.
examples: Is this genuine leather?
She has a genuine smile.
He showed genuine interest in my work.

spanish.definition: Real; verdadero.

definition: A dead person who walks in scary movies; a very tired person.
examples: I love zombie movies.
I feel like a zombie today.
The zombies attacked the town.

spanish.definition: Muerto que camina en películas de miedo; persona muy cansada.

definition: Related to electricity.
examples: The fire had an electrical cause.
He studies electrical engineering.
There's an electrical problem in the house.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la electricidad.

definition: A place for research or teaching.
examples: She studied at the Institute of Technology.
He works for a research institute.
The institute offers free English classes.

spanish.definition: Lugar para investigar o enseñar.

definition: A basic rule or belief.
examples: He's a man of principle.
It's against my principles.
She taught me the principles of cooking.

spanish.definition: Regla o creencia básica.

definition: A person who treats problems of the mind or body.
examples: I talk to a therapist every week.
My therapist says I need to rest.
She's a physical therapist.

spanish.definition: Persona que trata problemas de la mente o del cuerpo.

definition: To try to win against others.
examples: She's competing in the Olympics.
Small stores can't compete with the big ones.
We competed against ten other teams.

spanish.definition: Tratar de ganarles a otros.

definition: Something nice you say about someone.
examples: Thank you for the compliment.
He gave me a nice compliment.
I'll take that as a compliment.

spanish.definition: Algo bonito que dices de alguien.

definition: The place where someone lives.
examples: This is the president's official residence.
She applied for permanent residence.
He has a residence in Florida.

spanish.definition: Lugar donde vive alguien.

definition: A system in which people vote for their leaders.
examples: We live in a democracy.
People fought for democracy.
Free speech is important in a democracy.

spanish.definition: Sistema en que la gente vota por sus líderes.

definition: An old traditional story; a false idea many people believe.
examples: It's just a myth that bats can't see.
We read Greek myths at school.
That story is only a myth.

spanish.definition: Historia tradicional antigua; idea falsa que mucha gente cree.

definition: Not able to do anything to help yourself.
examples: I felt helpless when he was sick.
The baby is small and helpless.
He stood there, helpless.

spanish.definition: Que no puede hacer nada para ayudarse.

definition: The feeling of wanting to eat.
examples: He has a good appetite.
I lost my appetite.
This walk gave me an appetite.

spanish.definition: Sensación de querer comer.
